method.compatible: all required identity, version, behavior and contract evidence exists and passes without weakening permissions or formal-write semantics
method.incompatible: a proven break exists in valid input, stable reference, permission, formal-write meaning or applicable contract test
method.unknown: no proven break exists but required evidence, rule, version or test is missing

decisions.stableRefBehavior: id/typeId/version remains explicit and version is compared exactly
decisions.d1Behavior: location objects remain stably referenceable as one of the five built-in world object classes
decisions.differenceOwner: representation mapping owned by the protocol compatibility boundary
decisions.migrationBoundary: read-only mapping until a future product migration is explicitly implemented
